display_long_description:
Step into a zombie sandbox shooter where physics-driven gameplay, a full-body controller system, and stylized action come together. Experiment freely with a wide variety of weapons as zombies react dynamically, lose limbs, crawl, and collapse in chaotic, physics-based encounters.
[media]
Players can physically grab, aim, reload, and swap weapons with intuitive motion controls, creating a realistic firefight experience that feels natural and engaging. Enjoy precise two-handed rifle support with smooth recoil feedback and interactive magazine mechanics.
[media]
Enemies are fully ragdolled and react dynamically to damage. Shoot off limbs and watch zombies adapt. Losing legs forces them to crawl. Instead of realistic horror, the game embraces a stylized, exaggerated visual style with non-realistic blood effects designed to keep the experience fun and accessible rather than disturbing.

Built as a sandbox, the game encourages experimentation. Test different weapons, and explore how enemies respond to physics-driven destruction. Every encounter becomes a small simulation where movement, impact, and environment all matter.

This gamefocuses on replayability, physical interaction, and satisfying VR feedback loops.
